activation.controls: Five required QZVP controls, prediction-only sites; no refit.
activation.joints: Five geometry-screened joints if matching primary mapping/units/convergence and inherited path consistency pass.
activation.precision: Two300x1454 grid comparisons, one tighterSCF center, four finite-difference points around joint040; within32cap. No other protocol ladder.
activation.primary: Ten missing exact dense-TZVP primary observations after controls native success; QZVP basis/grid failures do not gate a distinct target fit.
activation.validation: Three reserved configurations only after eligible training candidate; recheck leakage against every observed geometry. Otherwise remain untouched.

verified_fixed_response.interpretation: Total molecular path response, not an isolated source coefficient.
Total molecular path response, not an isolated source coefficient.

failure_policy: Every process attempt counts, including startup/timeout/interruption. Use existing run_job/capture hashes, retain commands/stdout/stderr/native errors/scratch. Resume only exact verified completed requests. A retry needs additive identity/amendment and remaining32cap; never erase failure.

fit.acceptance: Same frozen energy/force/max gates on untouched validation plus predictive uncertainty; method-specific research only, never automatic assignment.
fit.candidate_activation: Full matching primary+joints, numerical gates, rank59/condition<=10000, solver success, no active bound, training thresholds and uncertainty all pass before untouched validation QM. A failed historical complete-basis gate alone never blocks this method-specific trial.
fit.condition_scope: Actual weighted59column matrix including offset; 10000 is an experiment identifiability screen, not prior987 geometry-only result or a physical certificate.
fit.curvature_constraints: Diagnostics only; selected-protocol baseline estimates not QZVP. No duplicate gradient-derived observations in objective.
fit.objective: mean((E_QM-E_fixed-Ap-offset)^2)/0.1^2 + mean(Cartesian_force_residual^2)/0.5^2; all81 components, one offset on training only
fit.offset: one unbounded additive training intercept in energy only; frozen unchanged on validation; subtract center electronic energy before kcal conversion for precision
fit.optimizer: scipy.optimize.lsq_linear TRF bounded linear least squares, column-scaled including intercept, tolerance1e-12,maxiter1000; no regularization

uncertainty.interval: 2.5/97.5percentiles only on explicitly eligible bootstrap replicates; retain every rank/conditioning/bound failure, no replacement resampling; failed fraction blocks eligibility. Absolute intervals for all coefficients incl near zero, covariance/correlations and prediction spread; limited small-block/model-discrepancy uncertainty, no physical confidence claim.
uncertainty.unit: whole training configuration/path blocks; all signs/steps of each primary path travel together; each joint and center separate blocks

hypotheses: QZVP cross-site curvatures test frozen shared corrections, not independent basins.
Matched QZVP center grid contrast separates integration from orbital-basis effects.
A complete fixed+58unknown MM model may reproduce one dense-TZVP target; source-baseline incompatibility remains a competing hypothesis.

inherited.metric: Apply absolute plus relative gates separately by path, both signs and maximum/local Cartesian force errors, path forces/torques and curvature. Soft torsions use absolute floors. Two-step curvature is required; same signed displacement is compared for energy/force protocol sensitivity.

precision.policy: Mandatory native convergence,mapping,units and energy-gradient checks for fitting observations; two planned common-geometry numerical controls at center/joint040. Preserve original basis failures separately.

resources.QZVP_allocation: One worker only. J64 QZVP399->1079 orbital functions peaked~9.5GiB RSS with8GiB configured; allow12GiB RSS plus retained~6GiB unrelated anonymous memory within32GiB cgroup. Dense QZVP may cost more than682s center;7200s bound. Never concurrent QZVP/TZVP. Reclaimable cache distinguished from anonymous memory.

scope: Exact27atom HMDS method-specific research target, no physical/basis/transfer qualification. SiH stopped. Historical gates/author provenance unchanged.

validation_leakage.algorithm: distance-colored graph backtracking plus proper Kabsch; search cap fails closed
